properties.displayName: IT - Accounts Authenticating to New Hosts
properties.query:
let baseline = SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4624 | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1d)) | distinct TargetUserName, Computer;
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType in (2, 3, 10)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| join kind=leftanti (baseline) on TargetUserName, Computer
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Logons = count() by TargetUserName, Computer, LogonType

tags.name: description
tags.value: Accounts logging on to hosts they have not touched in 14 days. Baseline lateral-movement hunt across EMS/historian/jump-host tier. Expect noise during commissioning; valuable once steady-state.
